features.title: Support that wraps around you
features.text: Our sofa’s high backrest, filled with plush Recron fibre, is designed to gently support your spine, shoulders and head—so every time you sit, your whole body can let go and relax fully.

features.title: A seat you can sink into
features.text: Beneath the soft foam lies a layer of pocket springs that respond to your body—offering just the right bounce and a luxurious, cushioned feel you won’t want to leave.

features.title: Comfort for your lower back
features.text: With enhanced lumbar support, our sofa helps your spine rest naturally—reducing pressure and letting your posture reset, whether you're sitting upright or reclining into a slower moment.

features.title: Armrests made to welcome you
features.text: Broad and angular, the armrests are shaped to cradle your arms in a relaxed, ergonomic position—adding comfort and elegance to your everyday routine.

features.title: Upholstery that works as hard as you do
features.text: Made from high-quality synthetic leather, our sofa resists stains, spills and scuffs—so you can enjoy beautiful design with less effort, day in and day out.

features.title: Elevated for effortless living
features.text: Our sofa’s elevated base and sturdy PVC legs make floor cleaning easy while adding a light, open feel to your room. It’s a smart blend of everyday convenience and lasting stability.
